THE BRIEF REASONS FOR THE JUDGMENT  BRIEF SYNOPSIS OF THE CASE 1.

The case of the prosecution in brief is, that the present FIR was lodged on the complaint of one Mr. Pankaj Jain, wherein it was alleged, that merely 50,900 shares of M/s Hi-Tech Drugs Ltd. were sold to the complainant between 14.02.1995 to 10.03.1995 through 8 different bills by accused P.K.
Wadhwa and Naveen Kumar Wadhwa of P.K. Wadhwa and Company.
The complainant further sold these shares that were bought by him from P.K. Wadhwa and company through their corresponding brokers at Bombay Stock Exchange and received the payments in this regard.

However, later on it was learnt by the complainant through their brokers that the shares they had purchased from P.K. Wadhwa and Company were stolen shares and the company had already issued advertisement in newspaper in this regard.
Thereafter, the complainant received back the shares from their Bombay broker after making payment.

In the similar manner, another company namely M/s Vikas Holding Pvt. Ltd. being a registered member of Delhi Stock Ltd had also alleged that merely 1,50,000 equity shares of M/s Hi-Tech Drugs Ltd were purchased by them on the floor of Delhi stock exchange from M/s P.K. Wadhwa and company and they paid Rs. 35 lacs in this regard.

These shares were also in the similar fashion sold to large number of investors at Bombay through their Bombay brokers i.e M/s M. Damani, a registered member of Bombay Stock Exchange but the said company refused to transfer the shares stating that these were lost / stolen shares.

They further came to know, that the management of the company had published in the newspaper namely Prasaran dated 11.03.1995 at Ratlam stating therein that 3,64,800 shares of theirs were stolen from their share department.
It is further alleged, that most of the signatures on transfer deed were witnessed by Manoj Kejriwal i.e one of the accused in the present case.

415-cheating:- "who ever, by deceiving any person, fraudulently or dishonestly induces the person so deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to consent that any person shall retain any property, or intentionally induces the person so deceived to do or omit to do anything which he would not do or omit if he were not so deceived, and which Act or omission causes or is likely to cause damage or harm to that person in body, mind, reputation or property is said to cheat".
